text: The Northern Mariana Islands is a United States overseas territory. As such, it is counted as **the US** for country streaks purposes.
text_zh: 北馬利安納群島是美國海外屬地。因此，就國家連勝（country streaks）的計算而言，它被視為**美國**。

text: The entire Google car is blurred, however an antenna at the front right can be seen. The antenna is also **noticeably closer** to the camera than in the Guam Google car.
text_zh: 整台 Google 車都有模糊處理，不過可以看見右前方有一支天線。這支天線也比關島 Google 車**明顯更靠近**相機。

text: Northern Mariana Islands have **wooden poles**, frequently with a crossbar at the top.
NOTE: Guam typically has concrete poles.
text_zh: 北馬利安納群島有**木造電線桿**，頂端通常附有橫木。
注意：關島通常為混凝土電線桿。

text: The Northern Mariana Islands uses **blue** street signs, unlike Guam, which use green street signs.
text_zh: 北馬利安納群島使用**藍色**的街道指標，不同於使用綠色街道指標的關島。

text: Northern Mariana Islands have a **tropical climate** with a lot of dense and somewhat low vegetation.
text_zh: 北馬利安納群島屬於**熱帶氣候**，擁有大量茂密且稍微低矮的植被。

text: Royal Poinciana, Flamboyant Tree or Flame Tree ([Delonix Regia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Delonix_regia)) is the official tree of the Northern Mariana Islands and very common to see in the territory. Its **wide crown** with **bright red flowers** is easy to recognize.
NOTE: This tree is not common in Guam.
text_zh: 鳳凰木、火焰樹（[Delonix Regia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Delonix_regia)）是北馬利安納群島的官方代表樹木，在該領土非常常見。它**寬闊的樹冠**和**鮮紅的花朵**很容易辨認。
注意：這種樹在關島並不常見。

text: Both Northern Mariana Islands and Guam often have a very **large number **of** road reflectors**.
text_zh: 北馬利安納群島和關島通常都有**數量非常多**的**道路反光片**。

text: **East Asian languages** such as Japanese, Chinese, Korean, and even Russian are common to see in the Northern Mariana Islands.
NOTE: This is also the case in Guam.
text_zh: 在北馬利安納群島常見到**東亞語言**，例如日文、中文、韓文，甚至是俄文。

text: The only island with car coverage is the main island of **Saipan**. The islands north of that have no coverage. Tinian and Sinapalu south of Saipan only have **tripod** coverage.
text_zh: 唯一有汽車街景覆蓋的島嶼是主島**塞班島**。其北方的島嶼沒有覆蓋。塞班島南方的天寧島和羅塔島（Sinapalu）僅有**三腳架**街景覆蓋。

text: **Dense commercial areas** can be found on the southern half of the west coast.
text_zh: **密集的商業區**可以在西海岸的南半部找到。

text: The **Suicide Cliff** is a steep cliff with a lot of exposed rock near the northern tip of the island.
text_zh: **萬歲崖**（Suicide Cliff）是島嶼北端附近一處有許多裸露岩石的陡峭懸崖。
